zh_summary: @TheTranscript_ quotes the $AXP American Express CEO saying that, like banks blocking AI assistants, Amex will take a risk based approach and will only allow agents to access its systems if they are approved through API or MCP channels, in order to protect customers and merchants.

text: $AXP American Express CEO: "you've heard a lot about banks that are blocking. And look, we're going to take a risk-based approach, too. We're just not going to let assistants run rogue through our systems. And that's not going to happen. We need to protect our customers, merchants, and we're only going to allow agents to access our systems that are either approved through API or MCP channels."
